description:
This semi-detached property offers spacious accommodation arranged over three floors, an ideal home for a variety of buyers in particular families, multi-generational living and investors alike, who are looking for somewhere with that extra bit of space.

The accommodation in brief comprises, to the ground floor level, an entrance hallway with door to the front, window to the side and a staircase rising to the first floor.

The good-sized dual-aspect lounge has an inset fireplace, laminated flooring, window to the front and French doors with side window to the rear opening to a conservatory with French doors to the rear garden.

The fitted kitchen has wall and base units with work surfaces over and incorporates a stainless-steel sink, oven with gas hob, plumbing for an automatic washing machine, space for fridge freezer, under stair storage cupboard, window to the rear and door to the side.

To the first floor a landing has three windows, two to the side and one to the front, a staircase rising to the second floor accommodation and provides access to two double bedrooms and the house bathroom which incorporates part ceramic tiled walls, bath, chrome heated ladder towel rail, window to the rear and to the side.

To the second floor there are two further bedrooms, one double and one single, both with windows to the rear and the 3rd bedroom has eaves storage.

Outside, to the front of the property is a block paved driveway providing off-street parking, with steps leading up to the front entrance, and gated access to the side and rear. To the rear is a flagged patio, brick shed and stairs leading to one of the main features of this property, a generous garden laid to lawn and to the back of the garden is a fenced off section surrounded by fruit trees, with a further storage shed. This garden has many possibilities, and enough space for all your garden furniture, BBQ, entertaining and enjoying those sunny days.

Situated to the East of Leeds City Centre LS14 enjoys a good range of local amenities with convenient transportation links to the A58 Wetherby Road, A64 York Road, Leeds Outer Ring Road, the A1/M1 Link Road, and East Leeds Orbital Route. Good vehicular access to Crossgates with its wealth of amenities including the Crossgates Shopping Centre, pubs, restaurants, micro bars, and local Railway Station. Further shopping centres can be found at Seacroft which also has a bus station and The Springs at Thorpe Park. Locally there is also JD gym, a veterinary surgery, Ninja Warriors UK, Flip Out and schools and nurseries.

Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Checks - As part of making an offer, we’re required by law to complete Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks to confirm the identity of all purchasers. To cover the cost of this process, a fee of £60 inc VAT per buyer is payable when your offer is accepted. This is a standard requirement for all buyers and helps us ensure your offer can be progressed as quickly and smoothly as possible.

Plot 45 - The Elliston is a beautifully designed four-bedroom home arranged over three floors, offering spacious and flexible accommodation that's perfect for modern family living.

The ground floor features a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a generous living room, providing the ideal space to relax and unwind. To the rear of the property, the contemporary open-plan kitchen and dining area creates a sociable hub of the home, with French doors opening onto the garden, making it perfect for entertaining family and friends. A convenient downstairs WC and useful storage space complete the ground floor.

On the first floor, you'll find two well-proportioned bedrooms alongside the modern family bathroom. These versatile rooms can be used as children's bedrooms, a guest room or even a home office to suit your lifestyle.

Occupying the entire top floor, the impressive principal bedroom provides a private retreat, benefiting from its own dressing area. The spacious layout creates a luxurious sanctuary away from the rest of the home.

Thoughtfully designed throughout, the Elliston combines practicality with contemporary style, making it an excellent choice for first-time buyers, couples and growing families looking for a spacious and energy-efficient new-build home.
